input.overview: Stellar Wars connects its letter objective, feature banks, and end-of-ball bonus. Complete S-T-E-L-L-A-R through the center and left drops and W-A-R-S through the four return lanes; either word raises Bonus X, and finishing both awards 50,000. One completion of the upper-right three-bank lights the captive ball to spot letters, while the top 1-2-3-4 lanes provide the safer repeatable route to 5x Bonus.
input.simpleOverview: Complete the upper-right three-bank once to light the captive ball, then use captive-ball hits to spot S-T-E-L-L-A-R letters. After S-T-E-L-L-A-R is complete, captive-ball hits can spot W-A-R-S; completing both words awards 50,000. Complete the top 1-2-3-4 lanes whenever possible to raise Bonus X.
input.summary: Use controlled side-lane shots to reach the numbered top lanes and build Bonus X. If S-T-E-L-L-A-R is close, finish its drop targets, complete the upper-right bank once, and use the lit captive ball to cover missing W-A-R-S lanes. Treat center-bank Extra Ball progression as a higher-risk alternative.

quickInfo.name: Spot Letters
quickInfo.summary: Hit the lit captive ball; W-A-R-S is spotted only after S-T-E-L-L-A-R.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete S-T-E-L-L-A-R, W-A-R-S, or top lanes 1-2-3-4.

steps.text: Complete the upper-right three-bank once to light the captive-ball target.
Finish S-T-E-L-L-A-R with the center and left drops, using lit captive-ball hits to spot missing letters.
After S-T-E-L-L-A-R is complete, use return lanes or lit captive-ball hits to finish W-A-R-S.
Complete both words for 50,000; use the top 1-2-3-4 lanes throughout the ball to raise Bonus X toward 5x.

alternatives.title: Feature-bank route
alternatives.when: Use this when the letter drops are badly split or the captive-ball shot rejects.

steps.text: Complete the left three-bank once to light the upper jet bumpers for 1,000; complete it twice to flash them for 2,000.
Complete the upper-right bank three times to light both spinners for 1,000 per spin.
Keep feeding the numbered top lanes to grow Bonus X behind the feature scoring.
Build base bonus toward 29,000 with lanes and drop targets.
Complete 1-2-3-4, S-T-E-L-L-A-R, or W-A-R-S to reach 5x.
Protect the ball after reaching 29,000 at 5x; verify whether sub-5x Bonus X carries between balls on the installed setup.

machineSetup: Test all three drop banks and resets, the captive ball and target, four W-A-R-S return lanes, 1-2-3-4 top lanes, both spinners, the eject hole, all five jet bumpers, and the bonus lamps.
Confirm adjustment 27 for captive-ball and lower-bumper qualification, adjustment 33 for Bonus X carryover, Extra Ball behavior, and whether the eject-hole stop bracket reliably captures the ball.

cautions.issue: Two operator adjustments materially change the route.
cautions.response: Check whether one right-bank completion lights both the captive ball and lower bumpers, and whether an unfinished multiplier carries to the next ball.
